scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only geodesic hyperspheres in the standard unit nearly Kähler six-sphere. It does not classify contactness for arbitrary real hypersurfaces. The proof starts from the primary source's exact exterior-derivative identity and geodesic-sphere shape operator, then uses the anti-commuting complex structures on the horizontal distribution to determine the complete skew spectrum and contact volume. A symbolic checker replays the linear algebra and Pfaffian calculation.
title: Exact contact spectrum of nearly Kähler geodesic hyperspheres
